proof:
intro x
show (-1 * x) ^ (2 * n + 1) * √(4 * v - (-1 * x) ^ 2)
    = -(x ^ (2 * n + 1) * √(4 * v - x ^ 2))
have hsq : (-1 * x) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by ring
have heq : (-1 * x) = -x := by ring
have hodd : (-1 * x) ^ (2 * n + 1) = -(x ^ (2 * n + 1)) := by
  rw [heq]; exact Odd.neg_pow ⟨n, rfl⟩ x
rw [hsq, hodd]
ring
